exclude_endpoint_assessment.code_source: sold_comps.HARD_EXCLUDE_CODE = 'hard_exclude' — both new rules run inside is_comp_excluded, which folds into hard_exclude's single reported code (see sold_comps.py's HARD_EXCLUDE_CODE docstring: 'single-sourced here so ... the offline sweep can emit the identical string')
exclude_endpoint_assessment.reason: plugins/gixen-overlay/src/gixen_overlay/routes.py's api_comics_comps_exclude docstring states by design: 'A RAW row is never stamped by this endpoint, whatever is sent: every code in the vocabulary comes from a GRADED-mode-only guard ... A product_id that resolves to a raw row comes back in not_found — reported, not obeyed.' All 12 matched ledger rows are pool='raw'; 0 are pool='slab'. Additionally, comic_id is a required (non-nullable) field on CompsExcludeRequest, so the 2 orphan rows (comic_id NULL) could not be addressed even if they were slab rows.
exclude_endpoint_assessment.conclusion: None of the 12 currently-matched ledger rows can be stamped via the existing exclude endpoint. There is currently no slab-pool match to stamp either (0 of 16,825 comps rows). This is a real gap against the ticket's Done-when clause ('stamped excluded on the Mini') for the raw pool specifically — the endpoint's raw-refusal is a deliberate BUI-947 design choice ('silently thinning the raw pool is the expensive direction'), not a bug, so widening it was out of scope for this ticket (plugins/gixen-overlay was off-limits) and is flagged here as a follow-up decision for the EM rather than something this change attempts to fix.
